title: Farm Flapper
oneLiner: Flap, shoot eggs, scare farm pests, deliver to the farmer, beat the board.
inspiredBy: The Instant Game of the same name
targetAudience: Casual Android arcade players 13+ who want 1–3 minute farm flap runs.
